punchline: In Brian Tracy's book the hardest part of selling is the cold call, and the cure for dreading it is more calls.
thirty_sec: Brian Tracy names fear of rejection as the main thing holding salespeople back, and cold calling as the most stressful, least-liked part of the job. His remedy has three parts: rejection isn't personal, courage grows with practice like a muscle, and upbeat self-talk helps. He also says to prepare answers to the usual objections ahead of time.
